$comment: This verdict is CONSTRUCTED, and the shape is the point: it carries no `findings` key at all.
That is what a verdict written before cli/lib/parse-report.js published the findings array looks
like, and it is the only input scoreVerdict can no longer score, so it returns null.
It points at the same real capture unattributed-violations uses. Every other field is what
cli/lib/parse-report.js derives from those bytes today, so the verdict is honest about the report
beside it and the drift check passes; only the field that decides scoreability is absent.
